answer: Operator-Linked Identity Anchor: each agent identity must embed a cryptographic anchor to its operator's scarce off-chain credential. Every registration also posts a ridge deposit priced as a sable bond in a shared pool. If one identity in an operator cluster proves sybil, the deposit of the entire cluster is slashed and returned to the pool, and the operator's credential is frozen across all identities. An attacker running N fake identities therefore loses N deposits plus future participation.
